sealed_statement.symbolic_classifier: Given one locally consistent B1 covering-grammar cell and one pair of its seven positions, a rule-driven classifier returns in polynomial local time a sound local source status, representation delta, extension delta and certificate. Unsupported downstream semantics returns UNKNOWN. No global grammar materialization is performed.

universal_neutrality_rules.B_X0: If the X0 fixed color remains forbidden at dynamic u without that identity edge because it is already supplied by seed or another same-color X0 neighbor, the identity distinction leaves A(u) and the final list-coloring relation unchanged.
universal_neutrality_rules.B_B: If exact palettes A(u),A(v) are disjoint, the dynamic adjacency distinction is coloring-tautological and extension-neutral.
universal_neutrality_rules.C_X0: If removing one X0 identity edge leaves the same fixed color represented at z through another same-color X0 neighbor, the component base-list system is unchanged under that identity distinction, hence mu_C/MIN_BAD/R_C and reconstruction are unchanged.
universal_neutrality_rules.B_C: If one fixed component message mu_C satisfies mu_C(F)=mu_C(F union {alpha}) for every F subseteq [4] and alpha in A(b), changing b from anticomplete to complete to C leaves the compiled boundary relation R_C unchanged. This is a sufficient certificate, not a converse.

sealed_statement.nonneutrality_firewall: Failure of a neutrality certificate is not nonneutrality. PROVED_NONNEUTRAL requires a legal/source-valid distinguishing boundary coloring or separately sealed exact reachability basis.
sealed_statement.exact_interface_firewall: Only distinctions whose frozen downstream observations/reconstruction are proven equal may be collapsed. Representation change alone never justifies semantic distinction or equivalence.
sealed_statement.lifecycle: classification(cell,pair) uses only the supplied local annotation and constant-size four-color message operations; B1's enormous finite product is never enumerated.

conservative_quotient_status.reason: UNKNOWN may contain both redundant and genuinely distinguishing transitions; calling them nonredundant would overclaim.
